component.name: Java Archive Runner
component.summary: Run JAR files with a bundled OpenJDK

description.p: kjar runs Java archives using a bundled OpenJDK runtime, with a Kirigami interface for opening JARs and inspecting failures. JavaFX is included, and additional modules can be dropped into a user directory.
It can also generate wrapper scripts so the bundled JDK tools behave like a system JDK on the command line.

Please note: kjar bundles a Java runtime, but it does not sandbox the programs it runs. A JAR launched through kjar has read and write access to your Home folder and access to the network, exactly as it would under a system-wide Java installation. Only run JAR files you trust.
